scenario: LOPQ.3.2 — a declared adapter operation whose signature names an opaque type may take it. A service kwarg typed as an imported opaque type validates, and a `call` binding an opaque-typed value into that kwarg is admitted (the seal is on representation operations, not declared-op argument binding).
rules_ds:
from crypto import (Key, Signature)

service adapter.verify:
    kwarg pub_key: Key required
    kwarg sig: Signature required
    no response

schema Machine scope logical:
    pubkey: Key key
    sig: Signature mutable

rule r:
    Machine m
->
    call adapter.verify pub_key: m.pubkey sig: m.sig nocooldown

libraries.crypto:
opaque type Key       over Bytes
opaque type Signature over Bytes
